facts.fact: ICASA gazetted on 4 September 2026 a notice of an inquiry under section 4B of the ICASA Act into the impact of over-the-top services on licensees and the regulatory framework, inviting stakeholders' written responses to a questionnaire and public comment on a discussion document, with possible public hearings.
facts.system: ICASA market inquiry into the impact of OTT services on licensees and the regulatory framework (Notice 4129 of 2026)

note: Consultation fact from the regulator's own gazette notice; the s4B duty to hold an inquiry is not a rule requiring consultation, so no standing fact.
